newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial wins contract for casino.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial wins contract for casino.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Monday it has received a contract to provide its GameCash cash access services at Casino Magic Corp's Bay St. Louis, Miss. casino. The value of the contract was not disclosed.
Game Financial said its systems will become operational during the first quarter of 1997.

The company is currently operating in 73 locations up from 28 at the end of 1995. Including the location announced today, Game Financial has agreements in place with seven additional gaming establishments that will become operational during the first quarter of 1996.
Game Financial provides casinos with services that allow their patrons to access cash through the use of credit card cash advance services, check cashing services and automated teller machines.
Shares of Game Financial were trading up 1/4 to 9-1/4.
